entry.summary: For immediate release – 31 July 2026An outline proposal setting out a case for an Eastern Bay of Plenty Unitary Council was published yesterday (Thursday, 30 July 2026) as part of the agenda papers for council meetings next week.The proposal, developed jointly by Kawerau District Council, Whakatāne District Council, and Ōpōtiki District Council, will be considered by Whakatāne and Opotiki District Councils on 4 August; and by Kawerau District Council on 5 August.
